'''Oluna Biqua''' was a floating city on the gas [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. It was well known as a place to go for luxury holidays.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Metatheran Cartel]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Porthoy]]'' landed in the city, and the gas [[Trinex-M]] was released after an accident. It entered the city's air-circulation system and infected most of the population, giving them [[The Force/Legends|Force]] powers and driving them insane. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] gained a sample of the gas; this was used to create a cure for it, which was given to the population.
